CheckTitle: EventBridge global endpoint without replication enabled
Description: EventBridge global endpoints are configured with event replication disabled. With event replication, custom events are replicated to event buses in both the primary and secondary regions.
Risk: Without event replication, events may be lost or delayed during a regional failure and the global endpoint may not automatically recover event processing in the primary region after failover. This can increase recovery point objectives and result in inconsistencies across regions.

Recommendation.Text: Enable event replication on EventBridge global endpoints. Configure an appropriate execution role with least-privilege permissions for replication, ensure the primary and secondary event buses and their associated rules and targets are correctly configured, and design consumers to handle replicated events idempotently.
